Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced and relied on an erroneous line from the English Wikipedia page stating that Jean‑Marie Poiré is the son of “Daniel Poiré.” This is false; reliable sources (including the director’s official site) indicate his father is Alain Poiré. Introducing this incorrect claim early misled subsequent planning toward the wrong parent rather than promptly cross‑checking with authoritative sources.
